postal_system.assignment_rule: Cuba uses five numeric digits and the UPU addressing sheet displays CP before the code. Current assignment requires a pinned observation from Grupo Empresarial Correos de Cuba or an exactly licensed current UPU release. Valid syntax, a prefix, a postal zone, locality or administrative match is not proof of a current assignment, exact civic address, building relation, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A full Cuban postcode is routing-locality-first and is not guaranteed to be a polygon. No public versioned reusable nationwide full-code polygon release is asserted. An IDERC or ONEI area, GEOCUBA map, OSM object, Voronoi cell, buffer, interpolation, API cache or model surface cannot be presented as official postal geometry; source reuse rights and geometry authority remain explicit.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building, apartment, street, house number including s/n, between streets, neighborhood, postal zone, P.O. Box, locality, municipality, province and postcode separately. Synthetic fixtures contain no real Correos de Cuba or UPU result, address, building, organization or person.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as postal_area, locality, route, po_box, organization, delivery_point, other_special or unknown. A five-digit assignment must not be forced to polygon geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed explicit relation to a permitted building identifier and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, release, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. Postcode, postal-zone, locality, street, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: IDERC, ONEI and other Cuban administrative or statistical identifiers, boundaries and settlements are contextual evidence only. Pin division type, vintage, code and crosswalk; do not relabel them as postal assignments or geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted operator or licensed UPU observations and rights-cleared geospatial releases may normalize input, validate or enrich a candidate, compare observations, compress reviewed geometry, detect drift and produce machine-learning review surfaces. Every output preserves source and service version, request and input digests, observed_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and authoritative, official-derived or derived status. It never overwrites source evidence, manufactures official postal geometry or infers a house number, apartment, building, organization, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate time-bound Cuban postal observations, typed postal objects, permitted reference geometry, rights-cleared civic addresses, explicit address-to-building relations and administrative context to AGID cells without relabelling a source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official Cuban postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The Correos de Cuba website and dated UPU addressing sheet are not bulk-data licences. Current UPU POST*CODE data and API use are contract, NDA and declaration specific. Each IDERC layer, ONEI release and GEOCUBA product retains exact producer, access, reuse, derived-output and redistribution terms; public visibility is not open redistribution. ODbL material remains partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO CU scope and records land, cay, island, maritime, border and source-specific coverage explicitly. Postal, administrative, statistical, cartographic, civic-address, building and AGID coverage, asserted_by, legal status and vintage remain independent.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact civic addresses, apartments, coordinates, access points, organizations, P.O. Boxes, API responses, credentials and query logs can expose sensitive household, property or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; never bundle people, occupants or account secrets.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postal assignments, operator and licensed UPU observations, the dated 2004 UPU syntax sheet, legal and administrative changes, IDERC layers, ONEI releases, GEOCUBA products, community data, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source version, service version, release, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet partitions with source licence, release, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Restricted operator, UPU, IDERC, ONEI or GEOCUBA inputs remain private, gated or external according to their terms. Dataset Viewer is discovery and preview, a Space is a demonstration surface, and production AGID services must pin a Hub commit and verify artifact digests. Generated or modelled polygons remain derived review surfaces until promotion checks pass.
